title: Where tests earn their keep in a small project

videos.script: A small project does not need a test for everything. It needs a test for the thing that would be wrong, rather than ugly, if it broke. {{wrong}} In loanbook that is the rule of lesson 5: an item cannot be lent twice. If the page's colours break, somebody notices. If that rule breaks, two teachers turn up for the same projector, and nobody finds out why until it happens. {{rule}} loanbook has seven tests. One was written before its fix. And the most important one was checked the hard way: remove the rule, and watch it fail.
